title: Pipeline State (spec-workflow v1.3.0)
description: Single source of truth for a kickoff planning run (Phase 1-5). Lives at specs/{N}-{slug}/.pipeline-state.json. The orchestrator reads/writes it at every Phase boundary; the stop-round-gate hook reads it on session Stop.

specDir.description: Project-relative path to the spec directory, e.g. specs/003-user-auth/

currentPhase.description: 1=SPEC 2=PLAN 3=TASKS 4=Consistency 5=Readiness 6=Implement 7=CodeReview 8=QA 9=MergeReady. v1.3.0 kickoff drives only phases 1-5; 6-9 appear only in v1.2.0-legacy state and are driven by standalone commands.

currentSubStep.description: Fine-grained step within the current phase, e.g. review-fix-loop, awaiting-planning-batch-review

rounds.description: Number of review/fix rounds consumed in this phase.

marker.description: Marker filename written by the orchestrator on completion, or null.

lastReport.description: Path to the most recent reviewer report for this phase.

roundsPerPhase.description: Hard upper bound on review rounds per phase (decision D3). The ONLY place these limits are defined (M1 unification).

humanAckGates.description: Record of human-acknowledgement gates that have been passed. The single mandatory human touchpoint: the planning batch review after Phase 5 readiness (requirement alignment is implicit at kickoff start).

resumeHint.description: Human-readable one-liner shown on cross-session resume. Also carries redo context (e.g. 'Redo in progress: <explanation>') so a crash mid-redo is not lost.

escalatedToHuman.description: True once any phase hit its round ceiling and escalated.
